snippet.title: Van v. Vamp - Announcement Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
NEW GAME -- VAN v. VAMP 🧛🦇✝️
You are Van Helsing. The army of Vamps have kidnapped your wife -- because they're in love with *you*.

A break-neck comedy revenge FPS. Rescue your wife Imogen from the wicked Count and his entourage, the Fanged Five.
